We are a rabbit, guinea pig and small animal rescue based in Eastbourne, East sussex.
Just spreading the love we have for our rescue animals by sharing videos with you all.
If you are interested in adopting one of our beautiful rescue animals we can be contacted as below.

WEBSITE: Www.eastbournerabbitrescue.co.uk

FB GROUP: Eastbourne Rabbit Rescue

TWITTER: @RabbitRescueEB
